data.exact_reserve_text: The contribution from the run off years' gross reserve release was GBP 16.2 million (2013: GBP 16.9 million) which relates to improvements to the incurred claims position predominantly in the Third Party Liability Account of GBP 7.4 million (2013 : GBP 10.7 million) and RI acceptances of GBP 4.2 million (2013 : GBP 4.2 million).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of reserves following favourable settlement of claims relating to Italian medical malpractice

named_events.loss_description: mentioned as a major claims issue from which releases were achieved

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prior-year reserve release of GBP 16.2m in 2014, driven by favourable developments in run-off years, predominantly in the Third Party Liability account (GBP 7.4m) and reinsurance acceptances (GBP 4.2m). Management attributes the release to favourable settlements (including releases related to Italian medical malpractice) and reduced IBNR, producing an overall prior-year release.
raw_causal_phrases: The contribution from the run off years' gross reserve release was GBP 16.2 million (2013: GBP 16.9 million) which relates to improvements to the incurred claims position predominantly in the Third Party Liability Account of GBP 7.4 million (2013 : GBP 10.7 million) and RI acceptances of GBP 4.2 million (2013 : GBP 4.2 million).
trend of reductions in incurred claims due to favourable settlement of claims, including releases from major claims issues such as Italian Medical Malpractice.
This favourable experience is reflected in the reductions that have been applied to the held IBNR reserves.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' (2013 column). Prior-year development (gross) taken from Managing Agent narrative stating 'run off years' gross reserve release was GBP 16.2 million' (explicit gross amount). Segmental premium mix uses the Direct insurance subtotal and Reinsurance subtotal from the regulatory segmental table (these two line-items sum to the reported total). No gross claims development (triangle) table was found in the extracted pages; some granular direct-insurance class amounts were present but this extraction uses the Direct insurance subtotal to avoid mis-reading small printed rows.
